name: Reaparr
description: REAPARR is a cross-platform Plex media downloader that automates adding media from other Plex servers into your own.

paths.name: Download Folder (Container Path: /Downloads)
paths.description: All in progress downloads will be temporarily stored here

paths.name: Movie Destination Folder (Container Path: /Movies)
paths.description: Default folder for Movies that have finished downloading

paths.name: Tv-Show Destination Folder (Container Path: /TvShows)
paths.description: Default folder for TvShows that have finished downloading

paths.name: Music Destination Folder (Container Path: /Music)
paths.description: (NOT IN USE YET) Default folder for Music that have finished downloading

paths.name: Photos Destination Folder (Container Path: /Photos)
paths.description: (NOT IN USE YET) Default folder for Photos that have finished downloading

paths.name: Other Destination Folder (Container Path: /Other)
paths.description: (NOT IN USE YET) Default folder for unknown media that have finished downloading

variables.name: PUID
variables.description: UserID which is used for setting file permissions

variables.name: PGID
variables.description: GroupID which is used for setting file permissions

variables.name: UMASK
variables.description: Controls permissions for newly created files and folders. Default 002 creates files as 0664 and folders as 0775.

variables.name: UNMASKED
variables.description: Unmask sensitive data in logs if true

variables.name: LOG_LEVEL
variables.description: Set the minimum logging level to show in the docker container, [VERBOSE | DEBUG | INFORMATION | WARNING | ERROR | FATAL]

variables.name: SEQ_URL
variables.description: Add a SEQ url to send Reaparr logs to
